# Town of St. George municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 22; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

offices.title: Town Moderator
offices.org_name: Town of St. George Town Moderator

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of St. George, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting of March 4, 2025: Article 1 -- Charles Scott nominated Steve Faust; nominations closed and the vote for Faust as Moderator passed unanimously
Town of St. George official website, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting of March 3, 2026 (town document center): Faust was nominated by Phil Gingrow and re-elected Moderator by unanimous vote

offices.title: Town Clerk
offices.org_name: Town of St. George Town Clerk

sources.note: Town of St. George, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting of March 4, 2025: the meeting's officer reports introduce 'Lisa Laramee, Town Clerk & Town Administrator, hired October 2024' -- the town hires its clerk, so she is seated APPOINTED, not elected (flagged on issue #163)

Town of St. George, 2025 Annual Report, '2025 ELECTED OFFICERS' and '2025 Town Officials / 2025 Appointed Officers' pages (officers with term lengths and expiry years): the officials page lists 'Town Clerk, Town Administrator - Lisa Laramee' among the town's officials, not on the elected-officers page
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Lisa Laramee as St. George's Town Clerk

offices.title: Town Treasurer
offices.org_name: Town of St. George Town Treasurer

sources.note: Town of St. George, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting of March 4, 2025: the officer reports introduce 'Adam Beach, Town Treasurer & Delinquent Tax Collector, hired September 2023' -- the town hires its treasurer, so he is seated APPOINTED, not elected

Town of St. George, 2025 Annual Report, '2025 ELECTED OFFICERS' and '2025 Town Officials / 2025 Appointed Officers' pages (officers with term lengths and expiry years): the officials page lists 'Town Treasurer - Adam Beach' among the town's officials, not on the elected-officers page
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Adam Beach as St. George's Town Treasurer

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of St. George Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: Town of St. George, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting of March 4, 2025: Adam Beach serves as 'Town Treasurer & Delinquent Tax Collector', hired September 2023, and the annual report files the delinquent tax collector among the town's appointed officers on a one-year term, so he is seated APPOINTED

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Joel Colf (Chair), Adam Dantzscher, Terri Hallenbeck, Asher Menashe, and Judith Scott; the directory predates Menashe's departure (see the town sources)

Town of St. George official website, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting of March 3, 2026, and the town's Contact List of September 24, 2026 (town document center): Judy Scott and Terri Hallenbeck each won two-year terms to 2028 and Adam Dantzscher a three-year term to 2029; Asher A.J. Menashe won the remaining seat (a three-year term's remainder to 2028) but the September 2026 contact list names only four members -- Colf, Scott (Vice Chair), Dantzscher, and Hallenbeck -- so Menashe's seat stands vacant and he is not seated (straggler)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect auditors (three, staggered three-year terms)

Town of St. George, 2025 Annual Report, '2025 ELECTED OFFICERS' and '2025 Town Officials / 2025 Appointed Officers' pages (officers with term lengths and expiry years): Auditors -- Caroline Jalbert (term expires 2028), Lisa Hodgkins (2026), Sandra Jarvis (2027)
Town of St. George official website, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting of March 3, 2026: Lisa Hodgkins was elected Auditor for a three-year term expiring 2029

offices.title: Cemetery Commissioner
offices.org_name: Town of St. George Cemetery Commissioners

sources.note: Town of St. George, 2025 Annual Report, '2025 ELECTED OFFICERS' and '2025 Town Officials / 2025 Appointed Officers' pages (officers with term lengths and expiry years): Cemetery Commissioners (three-year terms) -- Adam Dantzscher (term expires 2028), Mary Alice Favro (2026), Terri Hallenbeck (2027)

Town of St. George official website: the March 2026 annual meeting warning (Article 8, 'To elect a Cemetery Commissioner for a 3-year term expiring in 2029') and the March 3, 2026 minutes record Mary Alice Favro elected to that term; the town's cemetery bylaws describe the cemetery as 'maintained by an elected board of three cemetery commissioners', and the contact list names Favro (Chair), Dantzscher, and Hallenbeck

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of St. George Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists four St. George justices of the peace: Kelly A. Bowen, Mary Alice Favro, Judith R. Pillsbury, and Charles Scott

Town of St. George, 2025 Annual Report, '2025 ELECTED OFFICERS' and '2025 Town Officials / 2025 Appointed Officers' pages (officers with term lengths and expiry years): the elected-officers page prints five justice of the peace lines -- the four winners above plus one 'Vacant' -- so the town's slate is five seats with four filled

jp_election.name: Town of St. George Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the certified listing names four winners for St. George; the town's 2025 annual report prints five justice of the peace lines with the fifth marked 'Vacant', so the election's vote_for is the town's five-seat slate with four winners seated
